newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal studies restructuring defence industry.
newsitem.headline: Portugal studies restructuring defence industry.

text.p: The Portuguese government has decided to set up a commission to restructure the defence industry which is expecting a loss of three billion escudos in 1996 after a loss of 4.1 billion in 1995, a statement said.

The commission should present a plan including the establishment of a holding company for the defence firms and the possible privatisation of firms not directly engaged in producing arms, the statement said.
"The cabinet found that many companies linked to the national defence are characterised by low productivity and inviable production lines," it said.
Portuguese state defence firms produce bullets, grenades and automatic weapons as well as military equipment.
